_comment: Drop these rewrites into your EXISTING simplepresence.co.uk Vercel project's vercel.json (merge with any rewrites you already have). Replace YOUR-BACKEND.onrender.com with the Render URL of this onboarding service. Result: simplepresence.co.uk/agreement/<token> (and /onboard, /pay, /terms, /privacy, /cancellation) are transparently served by the backend — one domain, no DNS changes. Also set PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://simplepresence.co.uk on the Render service so the links it generates use your domain.
